parties: Zota Health Care Limited (acquirer) and Curexis Ventures Private Limited (target, wholly-owned subsidiary)
headline: Zota Health Care acquires equity shares in Curexis Ventures Private Limited via subscription to right issue
sum: Zota Health Care Limited has acquired 10,00,000 equity shares of its wholly-owned subsidiary Curexis Ventures Private Limited through a subscription to a right issue. The transaction was disclosed to the NSE on 22 June 2026.
implication: Acquisition of shares in a wholly-owned subsidiary via right-issue subscription is a capital-infusion mechanism to fund subsidiary operations; review whether this triggers any preferential allotment rules or regulatory disclosure obligations under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations if the parent is listed.
detail: Zota Health Care Limited informed the National Stock Exchange of the acquisition of 10,00,000 (10 lakh) equity shares in M/s Curexis Ventures Private Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary, effected by way of subscription to a right issue. The transaction was disclosed via NSE corporate action filing on 22 June 2026. The consideration amount and detailed terms of the right issue subscription have not been disclosed in the public announcement. As a wholly-owned subsidiary transaction, the deal likely falls within related-party frameworks but may benefit from exemptions under the SEBI LODR Regulations if the subsidiary is not a material unlisted subsidiary.

framework.note: Board approval required for acquisition of shares/investment in subsidiary; review if shareholder approval mandate is triggered.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 23
framework.note: Related-party transaction rules; wholly-owned subsidiaries may be exempt or benefit from arm's-length relaxations.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, Chapter V
framework.note: If right issue is offered to public or multiple shareholders, review preferential allotment norms; subsidiary subscription may qualify for exemption.
Right to issue shares at premium or discount; terms and conditions of right issue must comply with statutory thresholds.
If right issue is at concessional/nominal price, subsidiary may face deemed income under Section 56(2)(viib); verify pricing.
If parent acquisition is funded by borrowing, check compliance with borrowing limits under MOA/AOA.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Schedule III (Para A Point 9)
framework.note: Material acquisition announcements and shareholding disclosures must be filed with exchange; confirm compliance with timing.
